title: Greer's 2001 National Press Club whistleblower panel
summary: UAPGerb tells of Greer's 2001 National Press Club whistleblower panel, about 2001 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah, this was in 2001 and he hosted a panel of whistleblowers

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that in 2001 Steven Greer, a UFO activist, hosted a panel of whistleblowers at the National Press Club, a venue in Washington DC where news conferences are held. One of them was Mark McCandlish, and a written disclosure briefing document went with the event. The point, as told, was for insiders to say publicly that the government was hiding knowledge of UFOs.
